about: The sources build.mjs reads by default. A string engine or journal path is relative to this repo's root, so "." is this checkout; an engine { commit } is this repo at that commit, checked out as a worktree for the build. /mnt/project-files is the project's shared folder; /home/user/lanes are tournament lane checkouts from the scratch repo. A missing source is skipped and named. See docs/inspector.md.

sources.label: Blocked build, cleared and retried, 5 Nov
sources.note: Real run with live capture: real Claude agents started through the harness plugin's own hooks in headless claude -p sessions, so the trace shows each agent's tool calls, time and tokens. GitHub was a local stand-in server, and the origin refused workflow changes until the stand-in cleared it. The write-up is tournaments/2026-11-04-stage-contract/trials/blocked-retry/report.md.
